callout.title: Welcome to Berd!
callout.body: I’m Berdy – your onboarding buddy. Try getting started by taking a tour of Berd.

presets.useCases: What can I use Berd for?
presets.projects: How do I start a project?
presets.agentsAndSkills: How do agents and skills work?

presetResponses.useCases: Berd can help you research, plan, write, code, organize projects, and automate repeatable work.
presetResponses.projects: Projects keep related chats, files, and working folders together so agents have the right context.
presetResponses.agentsAndSkills: Agents give Berd a role and instructions. Skills add reusable workflows and tools for specific kinds of work.

1.title: Your canvas, your home
1.body: Keep the people, projects, and work you care about together on a canvas that is yours.
1.visual: A preview of the Berd home canvas

2.title: Chat with Berd about anything
2.body: Ask questions, explore ideas, and work through a task with an agent that has the right context.

3.title: Connect with all your providers
3.body: Bring the models and providers you already use into one place and choose the right one for each task.
3.visual: A collection of AI provider icons

4.title: Bring your projects to life
4.body: Group chats, files, and working directories around real efforts so Berd can help you keep moving.
